title: Coordinate-normalized cosimplicial product total data
statement: For a commutative ring $\Lambda$ and unbounded cochain complexes [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], coordinate-normalized product-total data is a functor $T$ from cosimplicial complexes $K$ to complexes with linear equivalences $T(K)^r\cong\prod_{n\geq0}K^{n,r-n}$. Its differential in these coordinates is $\delta+(-1)^n d$, where $\delta$ is the alternating coface sum. Its action on morphisms is componentwise. For each strict augmentation $a:const(M)\to K$ it specifies the map $M\to T(K)$ whose cosimplicial coordinate zero is $a^0$ and whose other coordinates are zero. This is data with the indicated equations; it does not assert the homotopy-limit theorem.
